territory.domain: Thompson 1917 claim validation - Ch. VII, The Forms of Tissues, or Cell-Aggregates
territory.claim: Cells in contact, like soap films, meet three-at-a-time at ~120 degrees and in other respects obey Plateau's laws of film configuration.
territory.organism: species-agnostic: any cellular tissue 'in actual physical contact by means of a boundary film' (Thompson 1917 p. 310); test specimens: Homo sapiens corneal endothelium, Allium cepa epidermis, Thompson's own Figs. 103 (Zea mays parenchyma) and 124 (Girardia epidermis)
territory.math_family: geometric (Plateau / Lamarle minimal-partition laws; Lami tension balance at a tri-junction)
territory.seed_landmark_paper: Thompson, D.W. (1917) On Growth and Form, Ch. VII, pp. 293-345, Figs. 100-135

match_assessment.species_match: NO for Thompson's named examples (he cites plant parenchyma, honeycomb, segmenting frog eggs, retinal pigment epithelium); the claim itself is species-agnostic so species is not the blocker.
match_assessment.variable_match: NO. The dataset is Fura-2 ratiometric cytosolic Ca2+ imaging (red/green/ratio JPEG frame sequences) of cultured normal human urothelial (NHU) monolayers during ATP stimulation or scratch wounding. The frames carry a cytosolic calcium signal, not a junctional (cell-boundary) label: tri-cellular junction coordinates and the three inter-wall angles that the claim is about cannot be scored from cytosolic ratio images with stated accuracy. 'segmentation' in its keywords refers to per-cell calcium-transient classification, not junction geometry.
match_assessment.status: DATASET_MISMATCH (variable mismatch) for doi:10.5061/dryad.mn8cs - NOT used for the verdict

fallback_dataset_used_for_verdict.policy: Per the claim override, when the named modern dataset does not match, Thompson's own 1917 figures from the pinned IA scan (printed page = jp2 leaf - 20) are the sanctioned fallback dataset; a CC-licensed real-specimen micrograph is added so the verdict is not drawn from drawings alone (and is labelled as a modern specimen, not as a Thompson figure).

thompson_1917_figures.role: Thompson's own biological exemplar of three walls meeting at 120 degrees with Plateau 'bourrelet' thickenings at the angles (p. 298)
Thompson's own counter-regime: hexagons 'distorted in various simple ways' by an 'asymmetrical component arising from growth or traction' (pp. 321-322) - still tri-junctional but not 120 degrees
